_comment_data_root: Override the on-disk location of data/price_history, data/journal, data/review, data/ticker_profile, data/ingest_log.jsonl, etc. Useful for moving the heavy regeneratable parquets out of Dropbox onto a peer-synced location (e.g. Resilio). Leave empty/omitted to use the bot-internal default (TradeHunter/data). Per-PC absolute paths: e.g. 'D:\HermesSync\MarketData' on laptop, 'C:\HermesSync\MarketData' on Hermes. Forward-slashes work too.
_comment_vault_dir: Override the on-disk location of vendor credentials (alpaca.env, telegram.env, intraday-premarket.env, etc. — the .env files that scripts._common.load_alpaca_env() and friends read). Same pattern as data_root: per-PC absolute path so credentials can move from Dropbox's VAULT/Claude Credential/ to a Resilio-synced folder (e.g. D:\HermesSync\Vault on laptop, C:\HermesSync\Vault on Hermes). Leave empty/omitted to use the legacy auto-discovery (walk up from SKILL_DIR looking for VAULT/Claude Credential/). Note: ibkr_secrets_path is configured SEPARATELY because IBC reads it directly, not via the bot's vendor.env mechanism.
_comment_ibkr_history_client_id: Per-machine override for the bulk-history-ingest clientId (resources/ibkr_history.py). IBKR refuses simultaneous connections on the same clientId, so the laptop and Hermes MUST use different ids. CLAUDE.md's allocation table: laptop=83 (default if omitted, set explicitly here for clarity), Hermes=84. Symptom of getting this wrong: IBC log shows 'remove Client N' repeating, watcher connects time out after 8s, supervisor crash-loops every 12s.
_comment_finviz_screener_url: Override the universe used by the dashboard's POST /scanner/yf_scan endpoint. Paste a Finviz screener URL here; the dashboard scrapes the symbol list from this URL on each scan (cached 1h per URL at state/cache/finviz_<sha1>.json). Leave empty/omitted to fall back to S&P 500 (resources/sp500.py). Edit the URL in this file to change filter criteria (cap, ATR, beta, volatility, etc.); no code change needed. The example URL below filters for mid-cap+ US-listed names with ATR > $2, beta > 1, volatility >= 2%, price > $20, avg vol >= 10K -- intraday-tradeable universe (~40-300 symbols depending on market regime). The optional trailing &preset= param is a user-specific saved-preset reference; not required for the filters.
